name: mp-relay-cloudflare
title: A Relay only match through the Cloudflare relay the directory mints, then through our own relay minted by the directory's coturn backend, then the host's own relay and pair entered by hand (Relay = Fixed), then Automatic, proved by the transport's own receipts
capture_policy: No picture: the route is proved by each peer's same-session selected-candidate and RouteAllowed lines on every connection, the ICE candidates each peer itself sent through the directory (a Relay only peer sends relay candidates only, each at the relay's address), every inherited relay setting cleared so the offer is the only relay a connection can hold (the binding 'by exclusion'), the directory's relay_offer_issued receipt for the session, fresh past the run's end. Labels and settings are never route proof. Every key and minted login stays in the driver's memory; the run's files are swept on each box (salted digests travel), scrubbed, swept again and only then fetched.

checklist.what: Both boxes run one executable bound to a build receipt at the same commit.
Each peer's runner hash equals its box's build receipt.
Cloudflare answered every credential request of the directory with HTTP 201.
The directory issued a Cloudflare offer for this very session, naming only Cloudflare's servers, and the client's report names a relayed connection at a Cloudflare address.
The host's transport selected a relay candidate and allowed the relay route for this session, and no other route.
The client's transport selected a relay candidate and allowed the relay route for this session, and no other route.
Every candidate the host sent was a relay candidate at a Cloudflare address.
Every candidate the client sent was a relay candidate at a Cloudflare address.
Both engines ended clean with their evidence.
Both peers recorded every frame of the 1201.
The live hashes agree on every compared frame and the traces agree.
Both peers hold the feel driver's gates through the relay.
No seat was held.
The transport's own round trip over the relay is recorded.
No file of the run holds the key, the token or a minted login.
